name: Abu l-Hasan Ali I
contribution: The second leader of the Husainid Dynasty and the ruler of Tunisia from 1735 to 1756.

checks.lead: Abu l-Hasan Ali I (Arabic: أبو الحسن علي الأول), commonly referred to as Ali I Bey (Arabic: علي باي الأول ;   30 June 1688 – 22 September 1756)) was the second leader of the Husainid Dynasty and the ruler of Tunisia from 1735 to 1756.
checks.photo: no death year in or after 1860
